tool_calls.input:
const luaCmd = `env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" -e '
local wanted_source = [[Increases weapon damage by %d%% and physical power by 30 when using swords, axes, maces, knives, or bows.
		You now also use your Magic in place of Strength when equipping weapons and ammo as well as when calculating weapon damage.
		These bonuses override rather than stack with weapon mastery, dagger mastery, and bow mastery.]]
local before = [[当使用剑、斧、权杖、匕首或者弓箭时，增加武器伤害 %d%%， 物理强度30。
		当装备武器、弹药或者计算武器伤害时，你使用魔力取代你的力量属性进行计算。
		以上加成会取代而非叠加武器掌握、匕首掌握和弓箭掌握的加成。]]
local after = [[当使用剑、斧、狼牙棒、匕首或者弓箭时，增加 %d%% 武器伤害和 30 点物理强度。
		当装备武器、弹药或者计算武器伤害时，你使用魔力取代你的力量属性进行计算。
		以上加成会取代而非叠加武器掌握、匕首掌握和弓箭掌握的加成。]]
local function collect(path)
  local records, current_section = {}, nil
  _G.section = function(value) current_section = value end
  _G.t = function(source, target, source_tag, ...)
    records[#records + 1] = {
      section = current_section,
      source = source,
      target = target,
      source_tag = source_tag,
      extra_count = select("#", ...),
    }
  end
  local chunk, err = loadfile(path)
  assert(chunk, err)
  chunk()
  return records
end
local base = collect(".ai/task/repair-w63-20261001/baseline/mod-tome.lua")
local now = collect("mod-tome.lua")
assert(#base == #now, ("record count changed: %d -> %d"):format(#base, #now))
local changed = 0
for i = 1, #base do
  assert(base[i].section == now[i].section, "section changed at record " .. i)
  assert(base[i].source == now[i].source, "source changed at record " .. i)
  assert(base[i].source_tag == now[i].source_tag, "source_tag changed at record " .. i)
  assert(base[i].extra_count == now[i].extra_count, "extra argument count changed at record " .. i)
  if base[i].target ~= now[i].target then
    changed = changed + 1
    assert(base[i].section == "mod-tome/data/talents/chronomancy/guardian.lua", "unexpected changed section")
    assert(base[i].source == wanted_source, "unexpected changed source")
    assert(base[i].source_tag == "tformat", "unexpected changed source_tag")
    assert(base[i].target == before, "target preimage mismatch")
    assert(now[i].target == after, "target postimage mismatch")
  end
end
assert(changed == 1, "expected exactly 1 changed target, got " .. changed)
print(("LuaJIT load and baseline comparison PASS: records=%d changed_targets=%d"):format(#now, changed))
'`;
const [a,b,c] = await Promise.all([
  tools.exec_command({cmd: luaCmd, workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation", yield_time_ms:30000, max_output_tokens:5000}),
  tools.exec_command({cmd:"git diff --check", workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation", yield_time_ms:30000, max_output_tokens:5000}),
  tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict", workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation", yield_time_ms:30000, max_output_tokens:12000})
]);
text(JSON.stringify({luajit:a,diff_check:b,lint:c}, null, 2));
